# data flow target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:dataFlowTarget`](gmeow-dataFlowTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/dataFlowTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The consuming [`ProcedureStep`](../classes/gmeow-ProcedureStep.md) of a data-flow relator. Functional: one target per data-flow edge.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:DataFlow`](../classes/gmeow-DataFlow.md) -> [`gmeow:ProcedureStep`](../classes/gmeow-ProcedureStep.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:dataFlowTarget`](gmeow-dataFlowTarget.md) from [`gmeow:DataFlow`](../classes/gmeow-DataFlow.md) to [`gmeow:ProcedureStep`](../classes/gmeow-ProcedureStep.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

#     not just an ordering).
ex:d1 a gmeow:DataFlow ;
    gmeow:dataFlowSource ex:extract ;
    gmeow:dataFlowTarget ex:transform ;
    gmeow:dataFlowEntity ex:rawEvents .
